title: C++: String Builder
description: Build an efficient string builder using ostringstream.

steps.title: String Builder
steps.description: Create a StringBuilder class that wraps ostringstream. Implement append(string) and str(). Test by appending 'Hello', ' ', 'World' and printing the result.
hints: class StringBuilder { ostringstream oss; public: void append(const string& s) { oss << s; } string str() { return oss.str(); } };
